description: This file is a shell script used for setting up environment variables, validating build targets, preparing directories, and executing build commands for a set of specified binaries within a build system. It includes functions for usage help, target validation, and extraction of shared library sonames, and handles platform-specific operations for Linux and macOS.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information about how to invoke the script with optional build targets.

methods.name: valid_build_target
methods.description: Checks if the provided build target is valid for the current platform (Linux or macOS).

methods.name: extract_soname
methods.description: Extracts the soname from a shared library file, using platform-specific tools.
